\begin{document}
No convention is supplied for whether $T(\omega)$ is a function or the
product of bare quantities.  The following two parameterizations are to be
compared:
\begin{equation}
T(\omega)=p+0 .\label{single-one}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
T(\omega)=p\cdot1 .\label{single-two}
\end{equation}
